title: Review code and plan fix implementation
summary:
Task: bookmarks button + dropdown for top bar (`add-bookmarks-button-dropdown-panel-to-top-bar-082d`). Locked spec: round button in top bar; default view = flat Bookmarks Bar list; "All Bookmarks" toggle switches whole panel to the non-bar bookmarks; no in-panel search (main search already covers it); click-through uses existing new-tab-behavior setting (pinned mode → new tab, current-tab mode → navigate in place); favicons via local `_favicon` provider, not Google's service; `bookmarks` permission already in manifest.json (no collision with background-sync task's manifest edits).

Implementation reviewed and found spec-compliant (`components/BookmarksButton.js`, `meridian.js`, `meridian.html`, `meridian.css`, build mirror in `meridian-extension/`). Four minor items flagged; user asked to fix items 1–3: scheme-aware navigation (chrome://, file:// now open via `chrome.tabs.create` in both modes), error handling around `getTree()` with new `renderMessage` fallback, and new tests (`tests/bookmarksButton.test.mjs`, suite now 12/12). Item 4 (a11y polish) deferred. Nothing committed yet; task still `in_review`.

Latest request: change "All Bookmarks" view to show nested folder structure instead of flat list — not yet implemented, need to revise `BookmarksButton.js` rendering logic.
